selection_protocol.selection_rule: Per base: IS-only (2005-01-01 ~ 2018-12-31) comparison of preregistered variants vs base. OOS (2019-01-01 ~ data end) consulted exactly once per variant for non-worsening check. NO OOS argmax. No iteration, no grid extension after measurement starts.

primary_hypothesis: H1: Under the v2.4_kr_retail_15bps DELTA cost model (harness default flipped 2026-06-11), turnover-reduction variations (holding bands / lower rebalance frequency / signal smoothing) improve NET performance of good-base screen strategies. This axis was structurally unmeasurable under the old FLAT per-rebalance cost model (cost was turnover-invariant; B0 forensics 04_Research/pg2_forensics/b0_fee_bug_report.md).
secondary_hypotheses: H2: top-N breadth changes shift the gross-signal vs idiosyncratic-risk tradeoff (AX-007 translation context); direction base-dependent.

H3: For fast-decay signals (momentum sleeve in VALMOM_AMP), quarterly rebalancing loses more gross alpha than it saves in cost (expected NEGATIVE for that base; preregistered to test, not to confirm).

cost_model.active: v2.4_kr_retail_15bps delta (per-name traded notional delta, 15bps one-way). Harness default since 2026-06-11 incl. canonical_screen_bt.
cost_model.legacy_label_warning: All registry full_sharpe values cited below were produced in the FLAT per-rebalance cost era (pre 06-11). Per B0: flat over-charges ~3x for one-way TO <= ~3x/yr and under-charges ~50% for TO >= ~10x/yr. Therefore each base is RE-MEASURED under v2.4 delta as the comparison reference; registry numbers are labeled metric_type=backtested_realized(flat-era) and never mixed with delta-era numbers without label.

evaluation_preregistration.metric_type_label: canonical_screen (all Track V numbers; engine = canonical_screen_bt / Return.portfolio infrastructure). No 'backtested' claim without forge build_bt_result.
evaluation_preregistration.improvement_verdict_rule: IMPROVED iff (1) IS delta net SR > 0, AND (2) OOS delta net SR >= 0 (non-worsening, point estimate), AND (3) cost-consistency: for turnover-reduction variants, delta annual cost ~ 0.0015 x delta one-way TO (sign-consistent and magnitude within rounding), i.e. the net gain is attributable to the cost channel rather than IS noise. All three required; partial passes reported as NOT_IMPROVED with the failing leg named.
evaluation_preregistration.reporting_obligation: ALL 38 runs reported (every variant of every base, including failures and errors). No silent drops. Verdict table per base + cross-base summary of which axes generalize.
evaluation_preregistration.graduation_firewall: Track V output = screening-tier composition knowledge only. Any forward routing to capital requires the unchanged graduation tier: forge-authoritative PORT_t >= 2.95, oos_retention >= 0.7 (v2 median 3-split), calmar >= 0.64, DSR >= 0.5 (sweep), book-marginal delta IR >= 0.05, governor manual.

implementation_notes.engine: canonical_screen_bt (02_Infrastructure/contracts/canonical_screen_bt.R, v2.4 delta default since 06-11) for plain top-N variants; banding/quarterly/smoothing variants implemented as preregistered selection-rule inputs feeding PerformanceAnalytics::Return.portfolio - NO self-synthesized return compounding (prod/cumprod prohibited).
implementation_notes.banding_definition: At rebalance t: incumbent stock kept iff its score rank <= band; freed slots filled by highest-ranked non-held; weights reset to EW over the resulting N names. Band is evaluated on the SAME score used for selection (smoothed score in combo variants).
implementation_notes.quarterly_definition: Rebalance only at Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec month-end signals; holdings static between rebalances (drift via Return.portfolio).
implementation_notes.process_discipline: Max 2 concurrent R processes, <= 4GB each (Cycle 1 workflows running in parallel).
implementation_notes.no_new_axes: Universe restriction axis intentionally NOT exercised (charter fixes K200 union KQ150). Weighting-scheme axis intentionally NOT exercised (charter pre-exclusion: weighting variations on composites all <= EW).
